reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Patient-paired multiomic treatment-associated program discovery, assay-specific preprocessing, primary late integration/enrichment and locked external cohort validation.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult original assay Methods, supplements or validated analysis protocols and check their transfer to the present inputs.
Sample pairing is assumed and a dictionary requested, but no independent sample-identity/pairing-integrity check is operational.

checks.quote: Use standard pipelines for the platform.
checks.reason: Normalization is not specified as an executable platform-conditional algorithm; comparing unspecified methods by QC does not determine the candidate method set and settings.
No explicit sign/orientation, normalization and missing-feature/modality denominator defines the actual score consistently across patients and external data.

checks.quote: based on the discovery effect size
checks.reason: Power simulation using the selected observed effect without accounting for selection optimism or variance uncertainty does not justify replication precision; no independent nuisance-calibrated detectable effect is provided.
Combining pathway p-values across correlated assays from the same patients needs an explicit covariance-aware or dependence-preserving null procedure.

checks.quote: Include patient as a group/random effect
checks.reason: MOFA grouping is not an ordinary paired random-intercept adjustment; the answer does not specify a valid paired representation/likelihood for the selected model. Official model documentation distinguishes group variability and covariate adjustment: https://biofam.github.io/MOFA2/faq.html .
No bounded factor/feature/regularization/missingness search or concrete derivation of range and search stop.
No explicit refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after revision following a failed validation.

An unpaired/differently timed cohort cannot validate the original paired-change estimand without a separately specified target and compatibility rule. Available single modalities also do not validate the unchanged full score.
No input hashes, exact environment/commands/seeds and raw-data/sample/output provenance sufficient for audit.
Inner-fold feature/parameter selection is stated, but fitted normalization and imputation are not explicitly confined to training folds.
A MAR assumption and complete-case comparisons are given, but no explicit informative-missingness sensitivity scenario; permutation nulls are not justified against time-batch nonexchangeability.
No clean-environment numerical rerun, table/figure tolerances or resource/failure/source-difference logs.

A useful patient-blocked, externally locked workflow with explicit association-versus-causation limits and balanced bridging proposed for confounding. Technical calibration and failure diagnostics are sensible. The menu of integration methods leaves tool assumptions unresolved, and independent validation/implementation details remain incomplete.
